entries.title: Lighter on your PC
entries.text: Nuru is a native app now. With a few sounds playing it uses about 14 MB of memory and under 2% of one CPU core.

entries.title: Keeps playing in the tray
entries.text: Closing the window leaves Nuru running in the tray. Opening Nuru again brings the window back.

entries.title: Update progress
entries.text: Updates show a progress screen, and a failed update says what went wrong.

entries.title: New icon
entries.text: The app icon uses the new Nuru logo.
